title: Pilot ingest, geocode, dedupe, and verify ~25–50 entries in one locality with full provenance
context: The pilot is the project's first published slice of real data and the proof of concept for the entire verification + freshness pipeline. A wrong or stale entry harms food-insecure people who may travel to a closed or moved site. Every entry must clear the verification policy (one authoritative source OR ≥2 independent signals), have a human-attributed verification for human-required methods, carry complete provenance (sources[], data_license, last_verified), and pass the operator-PII review. Depends on food-maps-schema-001 (schema) and food-maps-registry-003 (cleared sources).
objective: Ingest, geocode (open geocoder, confidence recorded), deduplicate (precedence rule + full source trail), verify, and publish ~25–50 food-assistance service entries for one locality. Each entry must: clear the verification policy with a recorded verification_method and verified_by; carry complete sources[] with license; have last_verified set by a human for human-required methods; have a correct per-record data_license; and pass the operator-PII review (pii_review set; opt-out/approximate-area applied where a private individual's address or phone is implicated). Closed/moved sites are marked, not dropped silently; low-confidence geocodes are flagged for review.
acceptanceCriteria: 25–50 food-assistance service entries (food banks, pantries, community fridges, soup kitchens, or meal programs) ingested for a single defined locality
Every published entry has complete sources[] with name, URL, license, retrievedDate, attribution, and shareAlike flag
Every published entry has a valid verification_method; human-required methods (phone-confirmed, operator-confirmed, partner-confirmed) carry a human verified_by attribution — no AI self-certification
Every entry has last_verified set within the freshness SLA and a reverify_due date
Every entry has a correct per-record data_license (ODbL for any OSM-derived record; not relabeled CC-BY)
Every entry has pii_review recorded; entries with plausibly private individual addresses/phones use approximate-area or opt-out
Geocoding uses an open geocoder (Nominatim, Pelias, or US Census Geocoder) with geocode source and confidence recorded; low-confidence geocodes are flagged
Duplicate entries from multiple sources are deduplicated with a precedence rule and the full source trail preserved
Closed or moved sites are marked with the correct operating_status (temporarily_closed, moved, or closed) — not silently dropped
A PR-tied verification-log entry is written covering: PR #, commit SHA, entries covered, sources/licenses checked, dedup/closure/PII decisions
The reviewer who approves the PR is distinct from the contributor who ingested/verified the entries (no self-approval)
All entries pass build-time schema validation (food-maps-schema-001)
output: data/pilot/<locality>/ containing HSDS-conformant JSON entries with full provenance + a verification-log entry appended to docs/verification-log.md.
